title: [Setup] jsii-pacmak local build workflow for non-TypeScript examples
description:
Establish and document the local build pattern that example apps in Python/Java/Go/.NET use to consume construct packages before they are published to public registries.

Define an npm script or Makefile target that:
1. Runs `npx jsii-pacmak` on a construct package to produce language artifacts in dist/
2. Installs the local artifact into the example app (pip install dist/python/*.whl, mvn install, etc.)

Document the pattern in a top-level EXAMPLES.md so all construct example tasks can follow the same approach. Include a one-liner per language showing how to install from a local build.

comments.author: resource-specialist
